name: Can deck resurfacing fix rotting deck posts or beams?
description: No, deck resurfacing does not fix major structural rot in posts or beams; these require significant repair or full deck replacement for safety.

mainEntity.name: Can deck resurfacing fix rotting deck posts or beams?

acceptedAnswer.text: Deck resurfacing primarily addresses the surface and minor sub-surface issues of a deck, such as worn boards, splintering, or cosmetic damage. It is not designed to fix major structural problems like rotting deck posts or beams. If the foundational elements of your deck are compromised by rot, a full replacement or significant structural repair is necessary to ensure safety and stability. Hometelligent Inc. will identify such issues during our initial inspection and advise on the appropriate, safer solution beyond simple resurfacing.
